Ode to a Moon is a first person thriller currently in development. As photo-journalist for a popular tabloid, you’re tasked with documenting a historic fall festival in a far away rural town during a centennial lunar eclipse. Camera in hand you set off to that romantic hamlet only to discover the macabre fallout of a town's descent into madness. It was inspired by real events and the belief that truth is stranger than fiction.

[list]
[*] Myst meets Silent Hill while on a stroll trough Tarkovsky’s Zone.
[*] A horror game without monsters or enacted violence. So no jumpscares in the traditional sense.
[*] First Person exploration mechanics with point and click adventure elements.
[*] Multiple endings = replayability!
[/list]

notes.title: Big VR Update for Oculus Headsets
notes.content:
[h1]This new update introduces 8 worlds to explore and was premiered in the Indie Megabooth's PAX East 2019 showcase![/h1]

At the moment it is only compatible with Oculus Headsets, the original SteamVR alpha is still available as a beta branch and can be re-enabled from the Properties Menu.

There's the retro Neon City, a beautiful Tron like CAD construct full of abstracted skyscrapers and doodle like forests. The bright Deconstructivist City, with towering shapes and labyrinthine alleys.  The Desert Canyon, a wonderful oasis whose ancient ruins defy gravity. The Tropic Island, rendered in a cacophony of primary colors. And 4 Edge worlds that truly bend the senses.

[h1]Controls:[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30292847/1d9f5d78da58cfe6750cefb76090409045e3b82c.png[/img]

Use the left joystick to move around the worlds, left index trigger to sprint and right index finger to jump. The right joystick will hard rotate your view by 45 degrees. You can move forward in whichever direction that you are looking at in the physical world.

[h1]Keyboard Dev Menu:[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30292847/141f12fe07cc97cac8c3518ea0965b533f9d0831.png[/img]

The Developer access keys let you force load multiple different worlds as well as Quit the game. When loading a world it will randomly choose from a variety of possible starting locations.


[h1]Important:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Only compatible with Oculus Headsets at the moment.
[*] Intended for a seated or standing experience.
[*] For use with Oculus Touch Controllers.
[*] This is still an alpha, as such there are a few bugs and discrepancies with the PC version.
[*] If you run into any problems, bugs or want to actively participate in the development process please feel free to post in the VR discussion board!
[*] To play the original experimental SteamVR compatible alpha, you can re-enable it from the game's Properties Beta Options, and is listed as "vive - SteamVR". The launcher option will not work so you have to manually access this VR edition: open the 0N0WVR.exe in the VR folder found inside your game's installation directory.
[/list]

notes.title: 0°N 0°W now available for OSX & Linux :)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30292847/404adc1dbb3576fc825c10bd107f762b62f2a0c4.png[/img]

[h1] Hey there! [/h1]

[h1]0°N 0°W is now universal! [/h1]

This weekend I quietly pushed an update that many might have noticed that enabled support for OSX & Linux. So now everybody can play! I'm very curious as how performance is in these platforms, particularly OSX as I do not have access to a Mac (those things are costly lol), so any feedback is greatly appreciated :)

Following the philosophical principles of Linux I've decided to strip 0°N 0°W of DRM for that platform, and will probably do the same for the other versions on Steam soon ( a DRM free version for all OS's is already available now on [url=https://colorfiction.itch.io/0n0w] Itch [/url] if you prefer).

[i]IMPORTANT: This update might have also triggered a re-download of the entire game and a couple of problems installing on Windows according to some users (since I changed the depots structure). This should be sorted by now but again any feedback is appreciated so if you're running into any troubles please let me know via the community hub Bugs subforum and I'll get on it right away.[/i]

Now that 0°N 0°W is available for all platforms I'll be focusing on VR :)

[b]Well that's all folks, thanks again for playing and a big hug/high five to y'all![/b]

[i]-Colorfiction[/i]


[i]PS: If you haven't already follow the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/colorfiction] Developer page [/url] & [url=https://twitter.com/colorfiction] Twitter [/url] to keep up with updates and new upcoming titles :) [/i]

notes.title: First VR beta and Soundtrack DLC now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30292847/22ecddb5b0743d838eee6392510e5e7f70e0dfb6.gif[/img]

[h1]You might have noticed a small patch today, well it added the very first VR beta of 0°N 0°W![/h1]

This beta release is a fully explorable build of the Neon World for you to get lost in! It is intended for a seated experience with keyboard and mouse or controller and should support all OpenVR headsets. You can most certainly stand up and do some roomscale wandering but just remember to return to your marked center point to continue exploring. 

[i]To access the beta navigate to the game's installation directory where you will notice a new folder named "VR", run the "0N0WVR.exe" located within to start the experience. Make sure you have all the dedicated hardware plugged in, recognized and SteamVR running properly before starting the application![/i]

[h1]Notes:[/h1]
 
[list]
    [*]This is the very first beta, as such there are a couple of differences between this world and the one found on the standard windows release. This will all be reconciled shortly.

    [*]There is no menu functionality yet as the menu system is currently being reworked to support VR. To quit the experience access the steam VR menu with your wand/controller and select exit or just press ctrl+alt+delete.

    [*]Doors and world's edge transitions are currently disabled, so please refrain from jumping into the void as you will endlessly fall :)

    [*]This is an ongoing development process so you might encounter multiple bugs! Please post about this in the dedicated Virtual Reality discussion group in the community hub. Any feedback is greatly appreciated and welcome :)

    [*]Steam did not review the VR DLC in time for today's release so this will be the only time that the VR is included with the standalone edition, future patches and development will be part of the optional DLC.
[/list]

[h1]The Soundtrack is now available as a free DLC![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30292847/bfc7262c2fedf1669d1ac7a2eebfbffaecbf13ed.png[/img]

It is a nice collection of songs from this surreal exploration adventure totalling at 19 tracks with a runtime length of almost 3 hours! Some careful selecting had to be done as the full ensemble is over 7 hours of continous audio so if there is a particular soundscape you would like to see included do not hesitate to ask for it in the community hub :)

[h1] Well that is all for today, enjoy the interdimensional wanderings in VR and hope the soundtrack improves your daily activities! All the best, - Colorfiction[/h1]

notes.title: 0°N 0°W: PAX East, VR and Soundtrack!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello fellow Dimensional Travelers! Have a couple of big announcements to make today:[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30292847/c7e016b4767ac5c1b432f951bb93305b198730af.png[/img]

First of which;  [b]0°N 0°W will be exhibited at PAX East[/b] in Boston this upcoming [b]April 5 – 8[/b]! So if you’re in Boston that week/end come say hi and stop by booth n# 11010, it’s right next to the PAX store and all the AAA booths at the far end. Not only will you be able to play the game if you haven’t already but there will be a live demo of the upcoming VR edition, and now that I mention that the next announcement is...


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30292847/296ad5811cec07c865fe4b04d17fc0b962ec6c95.png[/img]

0°N 0°W will support VR! After giving it much thought I’ve decided that rather than have you all wait for an elusive ‘When it’s done’ release date, the 0°N 0°W VR edition will be developed in an open ‘Early Access’ format, giving you all a chance to jump into this otherworldly reality as soon as possible! Best news of this is that it’ll be a [b]free DLC[/b]! Yes that’s right if you’ve already purchased 0°N 0°W all you have to do to participate in the VR beta is download the upcoming DLC, which will be available on [b]April 20th[/b]. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30292847/11dd5d34c73e1aa9f7d5d59a2a6568ffb304f25f.gif[/img]

That’s a short gif of some friends enjoying the upcoming DLC which will start off with a fully explorable VR edition of the Neon City. So you might ask why a DLC and not part of the game? Well VR involves changing a lot of the game’s architecture and shader format so it requires a complete rework of everything. Since it’s going to take time and will be developed in an ongoing manner there will be a lot of updates, the DLC format saves those that are not interested in VR capabilities from receiving this barrage of patches. So if you’re interested in VR download the DLC, if you’re not then don’t and save some bandwidth. Did I mention it’s free already? I did didn't I? but hey it’s Free! As in Air! Lol.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30292847/1f065782af9b29256b12755b17e1f48e83f0ba80.png[/img]

Today’s last announcement is that 0°N 0°W’s soundtrack will be available as a [b]free DLC on April 20th[/b] as well! It’ll feature a large selection of the songs in the game in their full length and best of all lossless Flacs (Mp3 will be included). So again this will be an optional download so as to save bandwidth and HD space from those not interested in the lush soundscapes from 0°N 0°W.

[h1]Well hope you’re all having a blast exploring and enjoy the weekend![/h1]

notes.title: 0°N 0°W Update 1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.2, Changes and Fixes:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Updated the Movement System: The [b]walking inertia/lag/delay after key-press is fixed![/b] Now you can approach things slowly or platform precisely without fear of sliding onwards (It's even more noticeable on controllers).
[*]Level Selection Menu is now accessible from the Main Menu. To do so click on the box full of tapes under the center table (the one with the 'Story Book').
[*]Added 2 ferns to the Main Menu and other miscellaneous embellishments. More importantly the Exit Game Door is now marked with an exit sign.
[*]Fixed cursor missing on Main Menu after rare instances of reloading .
[*]Removed cursor from intro splash screens.
[*]Changed Photo capture default key from 'P' to 'F12' to match the Steam Overlay screenshot function. This can always be changed to your preference on the startup dialog screen. Local copies of your photos are saved in your game's install directory as .png files '0°N 0°W/0N0W_Data/Photos/'. Currently missing update to splash screen diagram to illustrate this recent change, will update this in next patch.
[*]Fixed even more misbehaving doors.
[/list]

[h1] Also........ Big Announcement about VR capabilities this coming week! Stay tuned ;) [/h1]

[list]
[*]Updated the Movement System: The [b]walking inertia/lag/delay after key-press is fixed![/b] Now you can approach things slowly or platform precisely without fear of sliding onwards (It's even more noticeable on controllers).
[*]Level Selection Menu is now accessible from the Main Menu. To do so click on the box full of tapes under the center table (the one with the 'Story Book').
[*]Added 2 ferns to the Main Menu and other miscellaneous embellishments. More importantly the Exit Game Door is now marked with an exit sign.
[*]Fixed cursor missing on Main Menu after rare instances of reloading .
[*]Removed cursor from intro splash screens.
[*]Changed Photo capture default key from 'P' to 'F12' to match the Steam Overlay screenshot function. This can always be changed to your preference on the startup dialog screen. Local copies of your photos are saved in your game's install directory as .png files '0°N 0°W/0N0W_Data/Photos/'. Currently missing update to splash screen diagram to illustrate this recent change, will update this in next patch.
[*]Fixed even more misbehaving doors.
[/list]

[h1] Also........ Big Announcement about VR capabilities this coming week! Stay tuned ;) [/h1]

notes.title: Getting lost by degrees in 0 N 0 W
notes.content:
I m standing in Alice s wheelhouse right now and it is daft. Half these things aren t even wheels and I m not sure a cabin filled with vaguely circular objects is where the expression comes from. I don t know why she s built this.

But look here. It s one of those walking simulators she s always telling us about. This one was released last week and is called 0 N 0 W (or Zero North Zero West, if you can t stand degrees). It s a fantastical multidimensional walkabout through space and time , say developers Colorfiction. Well, I ll be the judge of that. Let s go for a dander. (more…)

notes.title: Reviews are in!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30292847/10ce62d33a2fc50afdaf734acddb8a62758149c2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Venture Beat[/h1]

[i]"0°N 0°W is enigmatic, made more so by the fact that you’re not presented with a mystery to solve. In this case, the journey really is more than the destination."[/i] [url=https://venturebeat.com/2018/03/01/0n-0w-is-a-psychedelic-stroll-that-meanders-through-space-time/] [i]Read the full article...[/i]	[/url]

[h1]Hardcore Gamer[/h1]

[i]"An amazing vacation into the unknown.  Each world has its own look, style and internal logic, and the best you can hope for is to understand a little of it before getting distracted by the entryway into the next new land.  While each interdimensional journey has a starting point at the main menu, the end is whenever you’ve decided you’ve seen enough and have had a nicely relaxing trip into otherworldy space."[/i] [url=https://www.hardcoregamer.com/2018/03/01/review-zero-north-zero-west/291958/] [i]Read the full article...[/i]	[/url]

[h1]Save or Quit[/h1]

[i]"An interactive take on a meditative experience. The gaming equivalent of Koyaanisqatsi or the classic end sequence of Kubrick’s 2001. It’s an audio/visual presentation where the viewer can get lost in the riot of colours, textures and shapes."[/i] [url=http://saveorquit.com/2018/03/01/review-0n0w/] [i]Read the full article...[/i]	[/url]

[h1]GodisaGeek[/h1]

[i]"Found a sense of peace within the riot of geometries. Each new level presented a different set of colours and landscapes, but always among the chaos was an overarching feeling that no matter how difficult the world looks to navigate, there is an exit and I have all that I need to reach it. This is where my own introspection really led me and that’s as much of a surprise as anything."[/i] [url=http://www.godisageek.com/reviews/0n-0w-review/] [i]Read the full article...[/i]	[/url]

[h1]OnlySP[/h1]

[i]"The foundation of 0°N 0°W’s art is a meditation on how players interpret space, design, and architecture within video games. The art does not just exist to delight, but to force players to think about how they interact with video games as a space."[/i] [url=http://onlysp.com/0n0w-review-no-direction-home/] [i]Read the full article...[/i]	[/url]

[h1]GameSkinny[/h1]

[i]"A game which serves as a catharsis. When life and other games become a bit much, I can retreat here. I never knew the weirdest game I would play would be one I needed so badly."[/i] [url=https://www.gameskinny.com/djkd2/0n-0w-zero-north-zero-west-the-intersection-of-surreal-and-unconventional] [i]Read the full article...[/i]	[/url]

Hope you are all having a lot of fun exploring this magical place :)

notes.title: The Door to 0°N 0°W is Open!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30292847/3b886339e5acfd831bfcff8349607f3f7ca94726.gif[/img]

[h1]Hello there fellow multi dimensional travelers! [/h1]

Wanted to remind everybody that 0°N 0°W [b]is Live Now! [/b]. 

Entry price to this magical journey will be [b] 9.99 $ [/b], and there is a [b] week long special discount of 10% [/b] to all early birds! This will be the [b] only discount for some time [/b] so take advantage of this special offer! 

If you're curious about what travelers have been saying about this surreal vacation here's a neat list of impressions and previews:

[list]
[*][i]"Find myself drifting back every so often because it never quite settles. I feel vaguely like a ghost with unresolved business"[/i][url=http://www.pcgamer.com/0n-0w-lets-you-wander-dimensions-develop-a-hangover/]  PC Gamer [/url]

[*][i] "I told myself two more doors and stayed for 10. I turned it off, walked away and came straight back."[/i] [url=https://culturedvultures.com/0n-0w-acid-fever/] Cultured Vultures [/url]

[*][i]"It's definitely got an air of genuine mystery that's hard to find in a video game these days"[/i] [url=https://www.gamespew.com/2018/01/upcoming-exploration-game-0n-0w-one-hell-trip/] GameSpew [/url]

[*][i]"Perhaps the increasing insanity of the environments was the game’s way of saying that life is too hectic; that I need to slow down and just enjoy the quiet moments? Or perhaps it’s simply about exploring fantastical and colourful worlds, escaping reality for a short time"[/i][url=http://www.godisageek.com/2018/01/0n-0w-is-a-kaleidoscopic-and-atmospheric-experience-straight-from-your-dreams/] GodisaGeek [/url]

[*][i]"You’ll encounter everything from beautiful neon Tron-like cityscapes to dark, rocky wildernesses.  0°N 0°W is truly unique in this aspect. I’ve never encountered such a concoction of landscapes and antithetical levels before"[/i][url=https://www.indiegamewebsite.com/2018/01/25/0n0w-preview/] The Indie Game Website [/url]

[*][i]"It’s a peaceful multidimensional journey that allows you to go anywhere you can see"[/i] [url=https://www.hardcoregamer.com/2018/01/25/get-ready-to-walk-between-world-with-0n-0w-release-date-trailer/287709/] Hardcore Gamer [/url]

[*][i]"0°N 0°W is going to be a visually spectacular. The environments are a riot of colours, lights, neon, and trippy effects"[/i] [url=https://www.criticalhit.net/gaming/go-walkabout-trippy-indie-title-0n-0w/] Critical Hit [/url]

[*][i]"A reality-warping trip through a glitchcore, impossible environment the likes of which can only exist in videogames, and that is entirely my jam."[/i] [url=https://www.pcgamesn.com/best-new-indie-games-pc-january-07-18] PCGamesN [/url]

[*][i] "It piqued more than enough interest to lead us down a rabbit hole of swirling, kaleidoscopic images, each buzzing with as much vibrant color as the last" [/i] [url=https://allgamers.com/article/919/the-screenshot-saturday-showcase-january-8] AllGamers [/url]
[/list]

Well, hope you all enjoy the bright colors and neon polyhedrons!
